description: This file defines the asynchronous enumeration request infrastructure in the Orleans framework, including interfaces, request classes, enumerator proxy, and related enumerations and exceptions.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerableRequest
classes.description: Abstract base class representing an asynchronous enumerable request in Orleans, implementing request initiation and enumeration proxy creation.

classes.name: AsyncEnumeratorProxy
classes.description: Proxy implementation for managing asynchronous enumeration over remote Orleans grains, handling request/start, move, cancel, and dispose operations.

classes.name: EnumerationAbortedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that an enumeration was aborted, typically due to errors or cancellation.

methods.name: InitializeRequest
methods.description: Initializes the request with a target grain reference and returns the enumerable.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Not implemented; throws if directly invoked.

methods.name: InvokeImplementation
methods.description: Invokes the actual enumeration request implementation.

methods.name: GetAsyncEnumerator
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous enumerator proxy for iterating over grain data.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the enumerator, releasing resources on the remote side.

methods.name: MoveNextAsync
methods.description: Advances the enumerator to the next element, handling remote communication and state updates.
